summary: Preview-only test of the two-step sign-in system (authenticator app + email codes), sign out of other devices, Google/Apple sign-in buttons and how pre-2FA tokens are handled. Backend: the existing tests/test_auth_2fa_sessions.py ran 11/11 passing, plus direct curl checks. Frontend: all flows were driven end to end with Playwright on a synthetic user (synthetic-ui-2fa@synthetic-test.co.uk), which has since been deleted. Every feature in the request works as specified. No blocking bugs found.
verified: The Settings 'Two-step sign-in' card (settings-security) shows 'Off', a 'Use an authenticator app (stronger)' button and a 'Use email codes' button

Authenticator setup: a wrong password shows 'Password is incorrect.'; the QR image (data URL) and the key are shown; a wrong code shows 'Incorrect code. Make sure your device clock is correct.'; a pyotp code turns it on; 10 recovery codes are shown; the state becomes 'On — authenticator app' with '10 recovery codes left'; the token is replaced (old token returns 401 on /auth/me, new token 200); the user is still signed in after reload

Signing in with TOTP on: twofa-screen shows the authenticator wording and has no resend button; a wrong code shows 'Incorrect code' and stays on the screen; a pyotp code signs in; a recovery code signs in once and the same code is rejected the second time (counter went to 9 left); cancel returns to the login form
Turn off: a wrong authenticator code shows 'Incorrect authenticator code.'; password plus a correct code sets the state to Off; the current session keeps working

Email codes: enabling sets the state to 'On — email codes' and replaces the token (the previous token returns 401); sign-in shows 'We've emailed a 6-digit code to sy***@...', 'It expires in 5 minutes' and the resend button; pressing resend straight away shows 'Please wait 30 seconds before asking for another code.' in twofa-resend-note
Sign out other devices: shows 'Signed out of all other devices.'; the previous token returns 401; the new token returns 200
The login screen shows google-btn and no apple-btn (providers.apple_enabled=false)
POST /api/auth/google {email, google_id} returns 400 'Google sign-in requires a valid Google token.'
Using the pre-2FA tmp_token as a Bearer token on /api/auth/me returns 401
Playbook checks: bcrypt hashes start with $2b$; the 6th bad password returns 429 (lockout after 5)

minor.issue: These do not record totp_last_step, so the exact TOTP code used to finish setup (or to turn off) can be used again at /auth/2fa/login within about 90s. Low risk because a fresh password is also needed, but it is inconsistent with the 'each authenticator code works once' rule in /2fa/login.
Turning off email codes needs only the password, not an emailed code. Acceptable, but weaker than the authenticator turn-off, which needs password + code.

ui_bugs.issue: The handlers for 'Sign out other devices' and 'Sign out all devices' have no try/catch. If the API call fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and the user gets no message.

issues: The heading says 'Two-factor authentication' but Settings calls it 'Two-step sign-in'. The naming should be the same in both places.

action_items: Optional: set totp_last_step when a TOTP code is accepted in /2fa/verify and /2fa/disable so codes cannot be reused
Optional: wrap the Sessions revoke calls in try/catch and show an error
Optional: rename the twofa-screen heading to 'Two-step sign-in'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is over 18k lines and should be split into modules. The new account_security.py helper module is a good pattern.
_admin_mfa_gate uses mfa_method({**user, totp_enabled: True}) only to detect the break-glass user. It works but is hard to read; an explicit break-glass check would be clearer.
tmp_token does not carry token_version, so a tmp_token issued before a password reset can still finish 2FA within 5 minutes. The second factor is still required, so the risk is low.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/_synthetic_2fa_user.py (new helper to create, reset and delete the synthetic user)
seed_data_creation: Created synthetic-ui-2fa@synthetic-test.co.uk (id 9a076b9a-...) in preview Mongo. Deleted it afterwards together with its auth_codes, mfa_acct login_attempts, security_events, and the lockout login_attempts from the 5 bad-password tries (acct, acct_ip and the matching ip-scope rows). Scope '2fa' rows keyed by tmp_token hashes from wrong-code tries could not be linked to the user; they expire through the 24h TTL. The admin and test@advocate.app accounts were not touched (totp/email_2fa still unset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To skip the intro in UI tests, set localStorage aa_terms='1', aa_cookie_consent='essential' and aa_welcomed='1'. aa_welcomed matters: without it, skipping the welcome tour opens the taster-lex modal, which blocks clicks. pyotp is available inside browser_automation. Use tests/_synthetic_2fa_user.py create|reset|show|delete for the synthetic user.
